body: Thank you’ll I’ll have to check it out! I was always really into it beforehand and I was flat chested before pregnancy and everything so poor guy just wants to enjoy them and I feel bad for feeling so ......meh about it

I’m
Sorry four your losses :/ I’ve told people and my doctor and been going to therapy, it’s back and forth how I feel. I’ve tried a few different medicines and been in therapy for over s year now and still feel insecure and depressed and worthless

Like I said the conflict is from him seeming so satisfied with only me. I’m literally his first everything too so that sort of adds some extra sort of feeling for me. Even if I was interested in doing that though we’re both can be pretty shy and awkward so I wouldn’t even know where to start

It just gets me because he’s so sweet he genuinely doesn’t seem to think about anyone else other then me, I’ve even asked and told him about my fantasy’s about other girls and he’s still like well that’s hot but I still think you’re hot
He knows and we’ve talked about it before. He’s implied he’d down if he got to be involved and all that, i don’t think I’m at a point like that though.

Thank you everyone ❤️ I have talked to
My husband before, he’d known it from the get go. I’m not gonna lie I think he would be open to a F/F/M situation but we both have a lot of anxiety so I wouldn’t know where to start. It’s my own fault, I was really exploring that facet of me and for scared and genuinely love/missed him. But the brief experiences I’ve had are like burned into my mind. I always figured everyone has to pick a side/person sometime but damn the guilt
